# Home-screen fonts

Manrope and Instrument Serif are hosted locally in `apps/web/public/fonts/`, so opening the
private app does not contact a font service. Both use the SIL Open Font License 1.1;
their license notices are retained beside this file.

Source: the `ofl/manrope` and `ofl/instrumentserif` directories in
https://github.com/google/fonts (retrieved 2026-09-24).
